_note: chars/token measured on the FIRST file of each source at its pinned revision, 400 documents each, with the dolma2-tokenizer (vocab 100278). Sets _CHARS_PER_TOKEN in corpus_build.py, which sizes each bundle's read budget. Reading too little leaves the last shard unfilled (a verify failure); reading too much is absorbed by pack as surplus. So the constant is set ABOVE the worst observed value, not at the mean.
